title: debrief improvement ledger
description: One entry per improvement an AAR proposes. Entries become devices (template, skill, hook, setting, status line) with a metric, not prose rules. Generation is P2; this fixes the shape.

target.description: What the change lands in, named by the profile (a template, a skill, a settings key).

metric.description: The recorded number that shows whether it worked.

applyPrompt.description: A self-contained prompt a fresh session can apply without the AAR's context: what, where, how, evidence, how to verify, and to set this item's status when done.
